fields.description:
Discovered during the DC<->Cloud test-parity re-audit (epic 3e73-72b5-cff2-40f0).

DC pins the empty-outbound-assignee behaviour POSITIVELY:
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_unassign_751e.py::test_empty_outbound_assignee_actually_unassigns`
and `::test_unassign_co_submitted_with_an_editable_field_does_both`.

Cloud has the implementation (bug 85a1, `AcliClient.update_issue` in
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/acli.py`: an assignee in `(None, "")` is POPPED and
routed to `self.unassign_issue(...)` instead of being sent to ACLI as `--assignee ""`, which ACLI
silently no-ops), but the only Cloud test is NEGATIVE
(`mutate/test_assignee_validation.py::test_update_issue_transient_error_propagates_does_not_unassign`).
Nothing asserts the positive path, so a regression that re-forwards `--assignee ""` — the exact
silent-success defect 85a1 fixed — would keep every Cloud test green.

Scope: TEST-ONLY. Behaviour-preserving; no production file is modified. The new test drives the real
`AcliClient.update_issue` with `unassign_issue` recorded on a fake and `acli_subprocess._run_acli`
stubbed (deterministic, no subprocess, no network).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] New file `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_unassign_6a74.py` exists and contains the
      Cloud characterization, with a docstring naming the DC tests it mirrors.
- [x] A test asserts that `AcliClient.update_issue(key, assignee="")` calls `unassign_issue(key)`
      exactly once AND spawns no `workitem edit` subprocess (no editable field remains).
- [x] The same assertion holds for `assignee=None` (both empty sentinels are covered).
- [x] A test asserts the co-submit case: `update_issue(key, assignee="", summary="new summary")`
      calls `unassign_issue(key)` once AND emits a `workitem edit` argv carrying `--summary
      "new summary"` and NO `--assignee` flag — i.e. both halves apply and the empty string never
      reaches ACLI.
- [x] A contrast test asserts a NON-empty assignee still takes the validate-then-edit path:
      `unassign_issue` is not called and `--assignee` IS present in the argv.
- [x] No file under `src/` changes (verified: `git diff --stat` touches only `tests/`).

## Testing

- [x] Proof: `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_unassign_6a74.py -q` passes.
- [x] Proof: `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass from the worktree venv.
- [x] Proof: the characterization is falsifiable — checked by temporarily removing the empty-assignee
      branch locally and confirming the new tests FAIL, then reverting.
